title: RBJ lowpass biquad coefficients
prompt: Implement `lowpass_biquad(fc, fs, Q=1/math.sqrt(2))` returning (b0,b1,b2,a0,a1,a2) for the Audio EQ Cookbook lowpass. Use stdlib math. a0 should be 1 after normalization (divide all by a0).
public_tests_hint:
- a0==1
- coefficients finite
- matches cookbook within 1e-9 for a public fc/fs
test_source:
import math
import solution

def _ref(fc, fs, Q=1/math.sqrt(2)):
    w0=2*math.pi*fc/fs
    alpha=math.sin(w0)/(2*Q)
    cosw=math.cos(w0)
    b0=(1-cosw)/2
    b1=1-cosw
    b2=(1-cosw)/2
    a0=1+alpha
    a1=-2*cosw
    a2=1-alpha
    return tuple(v/a0 for v in (b0,b1,b2,a0,a1,a2))

def run():
    got=solution.lowpass_biquad(1000.0,48000.0)
    ref=_ref(1000.0,48000.0)
    assert abs(got[3]-1.0)<1e-12
    assert all(abs(a-b)<1e-9 for a,b in zip(got,ref))
